attchmntText: Power Mech Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Power Mech Projects Limited has uploaded the audio recording of its earnings conference call to its website. The call was held on September 13, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. IST. The discussion focused on the financial performance for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The recording is available for access via a link on the company's website. M. Raghavendra Prasad, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication on behalf of Power Mech Projects Limited.

attchmntText: Power Mech Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Power Mech Projects Limited filed an investor presentation regarding un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of INR 1,609 crore, a 30% year-on-year increase. EBITDA stood at INR 187 crore with an 11.55% margin, while profit after tax was INR 88 crore. Year-to-date order inflows reached INR 4,801 crore, contributing to an order backlog of INR 56,729 crore. The presentation highlights sustained growth in industrial construction, infrastructure, and mining segments. Management emphasized strategic expansion into adjacent sectors and digital transformation to enhance efficiency. The document is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Power Mech Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Power Mech Projects Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of its unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. The publication appeared in Financial Express and Nava Telangana on November 12, 2026. The filing was made pursuant to Regulation 30 and 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The document was signed by M. Raghavendra Prasad, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Power Mech Projects Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Power Mech Projects Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The board also approved material related party transactions with subsidiaries, subject to shareholder approval through postal ballot. The company will seek shareholder approval for certain other items via postal ballot. The board meeting was held on November 11, 2026. The consolidated financial results include data for multiple subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates. Total assets for ten reviewed Indian subsidiaries were Rs. 732.42 crore as on September 30, 2026. Total revenues for these subsidiaries were Rs. 253.75 crore and Rs. 453.87 crore for the quarter and half year respectively. Net profit after tax was Rs. 10.00 crore and Rs. 0.13 crore for the same periods. Overseas subsidiaries reported a loss after tax of Rs. 10.18 crore and Rs. 9.98 crore for the quarter and half year.

attchmntText: Power Mech Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Power Mech Projects Limited has scheduled a conference call for Friday, November 13, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. IST to discuss Q2FY27 performance. The management will be represented by Mr. S. K. Ramaiah, Director Non-Board Business Development, and Mr. N. Nani Aravind, Chief Financial Officer. The event is organized by Ashika Institutional Equities. Participants can join via the provided link or by dialing the listed telephone numbers.
